description: Four extension substreams alone, each with an LBR asset: no core frame.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's parser reads the sampling frequency and the profile (DTS Express) from the LBR header, but its decoder rejects the substream ('No valid DCA sub-stream found', dcadec.c), so ffprobe gets no channels
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the LBR stub, whose component is a header followed by filler
